purpose: Grayscale painted material atlas multiplied by authored vertex colors
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production grayscale texture atlas for ten hand-painted forest village houses in a 3D game. Create one perfectly square 2048 x 2048 image divided into an EXACT 4 by 4 grid of equal square texture swatches with NO borders, NO gaps, NO text, NO objects, NO perspective, NO cast lighting. Every swatch is a flat orthographic material surface covering its entire tile. Neutral grayscale only, predominantly light gray values 150-235, fine dark details but no black outlines. Art direction: densely hand-painted opaque gouache / oil brushwork, rustic cozy illustrated forest village, tactile irregular chisel-shaped brush marks, broad warm/cool value masses expressed in gray, softly worn handmade surfaces, visible authored brush strokes, no photographic grain, no vector graphics, no pixelated checkerboard. Match a richly painted storybook rural house concept, not a clean plastic cartoon render. Grid content in reading order: Row 1: (1) mottled limewashed plaster with broad dry-brush patches and gentle paint wear, (2) dark aged structural oak with LONG vertical flowing grain and small knots, (3) freshly worn golden timber with LONG vertical broken brush grain, (4) a close-up terracotta clay tile surface with scuffs and hand-painted chipped highlights, NO grid of many roof tiles. Row 2: (1) a single rough dressed sandstone face with irregular painted stone facets and subtle moss specks, NO brick grid or mortar lines, (2) a darker cool slate stone face, (3) fine straw fibers running VERTICALLY with broken ocher-value brush strokes, (4) weathered wood end-grain with delicate concentric irregular rings. Row 3: (1) densely painted tiny leaves in grayscale covering the full square, (2) mottled lichen, (3) dark forged iron with brushed edges, (4) slightly rippled antique window glass of medium gray. Row 4: (1) dense short grassy sod and moss brush shapes, (2) woven reed basket material, (3) smooth dark antique window glass texture, (4) rough earthy soil with chunky painterly marks. All swatches must remain mostly mid-light gray so multiplying them by game vertex colors works. No simulated directional sunshine, shadows, building illustration, tile labels, framing or environment.
reference_style: houses_v2 concept art; opaque hand-painted rural forest materials
